Name: Famous Paintings
Author: DGlaky
Description:
Adds 10 pixelized versions of some of the most paintings in history using the Alternative Textures Mod. The following paintings are included

48x48 Paintings (Alternative Textures for Exotic Palace)
The Starry Night by Vincent van Gogh
Self Portrait Without Beard by Vincent van Gogh
Three Musicians by Pablo Picasso
The Persistence Of Memory by Salvador Dali
Girl With A Pearl Earring by Johannes Vermeer
Dogs Playing Poker by C.M. Coolidge
Shot Sage Blue Marilyn by Andy Warhol

32x48 Paintings (Alternative Textures for Squid Kid)
The Scream by Edvard Munch
Mona Lisa by Leonardo da Vinci
American Gothic by Grant Wood
Bold and Brash by Squidward Tentacles

64x32 Paintings (Alternative Textures for Jade Hills Extended)
Guernica by Pablo Picasso
Ignorance = Fear by Keith Haring
The Last Supper by Leonardo da Vinci

32x32 Paintings (Alternative textures for paintings similar in size to 'A Night On Eco-Hill')
Composition with Red, Blue and Yellow by Piet Mondrian
Knot (Pink) by Brent Hallard



Exotic Palace, Squid Kid, and Jade Hills Extended can now be purchased from the traveling merchant for 5000. They can then be changed into the famous paintings using the Paint Bucket item, which can be purchased from Robin's shop for 500g.
